content.text: If the arrows indicate potential motion paths for the person's hands, which of the following statements is the most plausible? Choices:  A. The person picks up the wrench by following the yellow trajectory. B. The person moves the wrench to the center of the table by following the purple trajectory. C. The person moves the wrench toward the wheel by following the green trajectory. D. None of the above. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
